title: Extend transient retry guidance across semantic tools
outcome: Agents receive the same bounded retry signal for the same transient semantic causes regardless of which semantic navigation tool they called.
acceptance: Permanent and unsupported failures do not recommend a retry, and no tool introduces an unbounded retry loop.
Product tests cover both a recommended transient retry and a non-retryable failure for each shared response path.
The capability is represented by its own features[] identifier and BuildInfo.Version is bumped.
definition, references, callers, callees, type_hierarchy, and implementations emit consistent retryRecommended and retryHint fields for cluster_cold_load and semantic_timeout.
